muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /events sse(Stream(ctx, send))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

// T does not define Stream: the synthesized send callback includes the
// options variadic so template-first iteration exposes the full surface.
type T struct{}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// impl implements the generated receiver interface by hand; compiling its
// method with the options variadic proves the synthesized signature includes
// it.
type impl struct{}

func (impl) Stream(_ context.Context, send func(result any, opts ...SSEEventOption) error) {
	_ = send("hello", WithEvent("news"))
}

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, impl{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/events", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if want := "event: news\ndata: hello\n\n"; !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
	}
}
